Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. Brijesh Krishnaswamy, the Chief Operating Officer of Beyond Meat, Inc. (together with its subsidiaries, the “Company”), and Adriaan Figee, the Company’s General Manager, EMEA, commenced employment with the Company on September 30, 2026 and July 1, 2026, respectively. On November 11, 2026, the Human Capital Management and Compensation Committee of the Company’s Board of Directors granted Messrs. Krishnaswamy and Figee restricted cash awards with a value of $600,000 and $500,000, respectively, which vest in four equal annual installments on the first four anniversaries of the executive’s start date, subject to continued service through each vesting date. The restricted cash awards were granted as part of their initial compensation package in connection with their commencement of employment. The foregoing description of the restricted cash awards is qualified in its entirety by reference to the form of restricted cash award agreement, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 10.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference.
